name: omxterm
description: Otávio's open-source personal desktop terminal for ARM64 macOS, Linux, and Windows
author: Luiz Otávio Miranda

scripts.check:portable: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/package-linux-assets.mjs
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --arm64 --publish never
scripts.check: npm run check:portable && npm run package:mac && npm run package:verify
scripts.check:linux: npm run check:portable && npm run package:linux && npm run package:verify
scripts.check:win: npm run check:portable && npm run package:win && npm run package:verify
